description: A list of strings and a tuple of a number and a bool unify to a list of strings
notes: The spec says list and tuple types unify by preferring the tuple type, so the selected tuple would stay a tuple of a number and a bool. hashicorp/hcl can't unify the tuple as a list of its own, because number and bool don't unify (unifyTuplesAsList in cty/convert/unify.go), so it falls back to choosing among the given types (unify), prefers the list type, and converts the tuple's elements to strings.
